expected_outcomes: Finds fail-open behavior: a read error or malformed JSON in the allowlist returns true (allow), so corrupting or deleting the file disables enforcement
Specifically calls out the unmarshal-error branch as the worse case because a present-but-corrupt allowlist is silently treated as allow-all while the log line hides it
May also note strings.HasPrefix without a trailing separator lets 'src-evil' match prefix 'src' (sibling-directory bypass); credit if present
Recommends failing closed (return false and surface an error) at least on parse errors, distinguishing 'file absent by design' from 'file unreadable or corrupt'
Rates the fail-open finding high; does not invent unrelated issues
